fix_subject: Fix common_subplan merging subplans whose children differ only in projection maps
pr_title: Merge #26542: Fix common_subplan merging subplans whose children differ only in projection maps

labels.summary: The common_subplan optimizer assigned canonical table indices from projection-mapped child bindings, so operators over different tables could canonicalize identically and distinct scalar subqueries were wrongly merged; the fix uses unprojected expanded bindings instead.
